ValidationRule.description: this is to restrict record edit for Paid or Denied claims
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(Claim_Status__c),'Denied'), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(Claim_Status__c),'Paid') ), NOT(ISNEW()) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Paid or Denied Claims are not editable
